# Ack/required args fail without touching missing input/output namespaces.
# Companion publication requires a private script-owned working directory.
chmod 0700 .
! skygo state artifacts backup --data-dir untouched --artifact-dir absent --output refused
stderr 'requires --ack-writers-stopped'
! exists untouched
! exists absent
! exists refused
! skygo state artifacts restore --input absent --data-dir refused
stderr 'requires --ack-writers-stopped'
! exists refused
! skygo state artifacts backup --data-dir untouched --artifact-dir absent --ack-writers-stopped
stderr 'required flag.*output'
! exists untouched
! exists absent
# Store's actual existing-only/membership validation refuses missing data/bundles.
! skygo state artifacts backup --data-dir absent --artifact-dir absent-root --output refused --ack-writers-stopped
! stdout .
! exists absent
! exists refused
! skygo state artifacts restore --input absent-bundle --data-dir refused --ack-writers-stopped
! stdout .
! exists refused
# A private malformed bundle is not adopted, fixed, or given a final destination.
mkdir tampered
chmod 0700 tampered
cp invalid.txt tampered/manifest.json
! skygo state artifacts restore --input tampered --data-dir refused --ack-writers-stopped
! stdout .
! exists refused
cmp invalid.txt tampered/manifest.json
-- invalid.txt --
this is not a companion manifest
